blocks.heading: The first pure vision solution for PSS certified

blocks.bodyHtml: By reclassifying to C53 capability verification, our customer equipped with C53 has officially passed Loughborough University’s PSS compliance test and has since been officially launched to the market. In this way, we are the industry’s first all-vision solution to pass compliance testing. As one of the most challenging validation agencies, there are several key challenges worth noting:Real-time warning requirements: B3 light delay must be less than 500ms, including vehicle start and brake signal delays, as verified by frame-by-frame playback of GoPro footage.2. The warning system must only be triggered when a threat is detected and is entirely vision-based. This means that the system must accurately distinguish whether a pedestrian is moving closer or slowly approaching, regardless of whether the vehicle is idling or moving. 3. The system must have very stable pedestrian detection capabilities, ensuring that there are no missed or false detections throughout the entire process.
